note: Attic of the third pronouns (cartoon style): sloping beamed ceiling, sage walls, round window, big blue travel trunk (landmark). dont (Spanish don with the feathered hat), moi-même (girl blowing herself a kiss in the mirror), elle-même (girl tying her own laces), soi (boy swaying in the hammock hugging himself), quiconque (whoever blows the conch wins the key on the door), auquel (letter handed to Kelly), toi-même (mirror held out to you), duquel (duck nibbling seaweed from the trunk), quelques-uns (calling the cousins: a few heads peek up the stairs). Stairwell down to the music room bottom-left; open white door to the starry observatory on the right.
